system.description: The Uchiha clan are often seen as unparalleled specialist of thrown weapons. Once per turn, when casting a jutsu that uses a weapon with the Ammunition property, they do not roll their ammunition dice. Additionally, once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] with a weapon with the Thrown or Ammunition property, you can force them to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save.
